_note: Single source for burned-in captions and the SRT. A cue with `fact` must match an id in docs/FACTS.md. Times are film seconds. `id` names the narration line (decision 0012); `say`, when present, is how the line is read aloud and must be the same words as `text`.

cues.text: The old bridge takes a cut from everyone.
One rower takes the river instead.
A digital dollar on Bitcoin Cash.
It is designed to hold one dollar.
The coin does not shrink on the way.
The fare for a real transfer: 219 satoshis.
Less than a tenth of a cent.
Bitcoin Cash. Money that crosses for almost nothing.
